  typeof define === "function" && define.amd ? define(["exports"], factory) :
  (global = typeof globalThis !== "undefined" ? globalThis : global || self, (global.MyLib = global.MyLib || {}, factory(global.MyLib, void 0), global.MyLib));
})(this, function(exports, require) {
  "use strict";
  // app.js

  console.log(answer);
  exports.answer = answer;
});

});

BundlerGuchhoJSON.BuildSplittingEmitsSharedChunk
---------- /out/a.js ----------

  shared
} from "./chunk-SOQI7MIY.js";

// a.js
console.log(shared);

---------- /out/b.js ----------
import {
  shared
} from "./chunk-SOQI7MIY.js";

// b.js
console.log(shared);

---------- /out/chunk-SOQI7MIY.js ----------
// shared.js
var shared = 123;

export {
  shared
};
